title: Restricted Access
caption: Restricted Access (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. I’d Just As Soon Kiss A Wookiee may not be played. After starting hands are drawn, to deploy a character for free (or 0 Force), opponent must first use X Force, where X = half that character’s printed deploy cost (round up). {alter}
lore: In an effort to direct Luke toward Vader, Lieutenant Bewil used his control of hatchways and lift tubes to cut off Luke’s support, limiting his options and resources.

Lore corrected from the scan: 'Lieutenant Bewil' (wiki 'Captain Bewil'), curly apostrophe in Luke’s. Two 350 px scans (CC-D-restrictedaccess.gif also downloaded; same face).
